# [t]guild

> [t]guild is a web design business. We build friendly, mobile-friendly websites for businesses (GuildPack) and personal branding portfolio websites for freelancers and creators (PersonalGuild). Slogan: "Tech made simple. Business made bigger."

## Key facts
- Every GuildPack and PersonalGuild package includes the domain for the first year at no extra cost (for example .shop or .tech).
- GuildPack 1: US$1,050 (was $1,400). 3 pages, 3 working days, 1 revision, 1 logo.
- GuildPack 2: US$1,350 (was $1,950). Up to 5 pages, 5 working days, 2 revisions, 1 logo, 1 extra language, 1 free extra design.
- GuildPack 3: US$1,650 (was $2,400). Up to 10 pages, 5 working days, 4 revisions, 1 logo, 2 extra languages, 2 free extra designs.
- GuildPack yearly renewal: US$500 per year (Rp850,000 on the Indonesian site, depending on the domain), paid in the month the website first went live.
- PersonalGuild: Beginner US$150, Intermediate US$550, Advanced US$1,400. Renewal price is agreed after the client chooses a domain.
- Process: tell us about your business, send a sketch (Canva or any app), we build it, revisions and domain choice, go live.
